title: Oil Rally Fuels Inflation Fears; Canada's US Tariffs Kick In
description:
US equity futures waver and global stocks slide as brent crude inches closer to $100 a barrel, adding to inflation concerns. Saudi Arabia halts some energy operations after attacks. Canada's retaliatory levies of up to 50% on US goods take effect. ASML wins TSMC and Samsung's commitment to use its latest chip production gear. Marija Veitmane of State Street joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss market risks ahead of the CPI report later in the week.
